_comment: Phase 2.2.5.3 long-document eval corpus. Synthetic, copyright-safe SEC-style filing sections (no verbatim filing text). Each chunk is a section child with parent_id/section_index/chunk_index so the hierarchical expander can be exercised offline. Cases cover the seven required long-document types; relevant_ids are the labeled evidence chunks a correct answer must ground on. context_ids are chunks that carry needed local context but have low lexical overlap (only hierarchical expansion recovers them).
